text:
alex: Quick thread — saw multiple p99 spikes yesterday during the EU->US cross-region fallback window. Profiling attached in-thread. Anyone seen similar?

maria: yes, I caught a few traces. p95 steady at ~220ms but p99 jumps to 1.4s when fallback happens. Looks correlated with routing to us-west-2 and model variant downgrade. :eyes:

ben: initial theory: fallback adds network RTT + cold KV-cache penalties for regenerated KV keys. Also kernel selection fallback may pick slower GEMM kernels on certain seq-len distributions.

jordan: I pulled a flamegraph from the serving node right when the spike happened. Hot spots: kernel dispatch (~48ms spike variance) and `kv_cache.read_miss` path that triggers cache repopulation.

perf-bot: automated-profile-summary: p99 latency 1.42s (window 2024-07-12 02:00-03:00 UTC), p95 218ms, throughput 240 rps. Top regressions: batching heuristics (+22ms median), kernel selection policy (+60ms tail), KV cold-starts (+430ms tail).

lisa: microbatch sizing might be amplifying tail variance. We default to microbatch=16 for throughput targets, but for short-seq chat workloads microbatch=4 reduces queuing jitter. Worth testing a per-route microbatch override.

alex: suggested experiment matrix: 1) force kernel_selection policy to prefer fused/kernels for seq_len<=512; 2) test microbatch {4,8,16} on the failing route under identical load; 3) temporarily disable cross-region fallback -> route to local degraded model variant instead of remote region.

ben: detail on kernel selection: current policy is `pick_best_avg_throughput`. For tail we might prefer `pick_low_variance_latency` for latency-SLO routes. Pseudocode: ```if route.latency_slo_ms < 300: policy = low_variance_kernels else: policy = pick_best_avg_throughput```

jordan: KV-cache notes: on fallback we see cache-key namespaces differ by model_id + region. When we route to US region, the cache misses and triggers expensive `kv.populate_chain` with disk read fallback for sharded stores. Short-term mitigation: ensure region-local KV shard replication/replicas or maintain a small staged prefix cache to avoid cold writes.

sre-ops: cross-region fallback policy currently prefers remote higher-capacity pools. That was intended to maximize throughput but obviously hurts p99. We can add an SLO-aware routing override: if route.p99_recent > threshold, avoid cross-region routes for new requests.

maria: I ran a local replay for the EU-chat route with microbatch=4 + low_variance_kernels. Result: p95 205ms, p99 325ms (vs baseline p99 1.4s). Throughput dropped ~9%. Logs: reduced queuing time, kernel dispatch variance down by ~40%.

alex: important tradeoff: throughput vs SLO. For product routes with strict p99 SLO we should sacrifice some throughput. For background bulk embeddings keep current aggressive throughput knobs.

lisa: action item suggestion: implement per-route perf profile config with keys: `latency_slo_ms`, `microbatch_target`, `kernel_selection_policy`, `kv_replica_preference`. Example: ```route_config {
  latency_slo_ms: 300
  microbatch_target: 4
  kernel_selection_policy: "low_variance"
  kv_replica_preference: "local_first"
}```

ben: also add metric: `fallback_p99_overhead = p99_with_fallback - p99_without_fallback` and alert when > 200ms for 10m.

jordan: on storage side, we can push smaller hot-key replication for conversational keys with TTL 10m to keep warm across regions. Costs something but cuts cold penalties.

perf-bot: proposed automated test: synthetic replay across EU->US fallback scenarios simulating 95th percentile seq_len distribution for 24h. Will produce a matrix of p95/p99 vs microbatch and kernel policies.

alex: OK — next steps: 1) perf-bot run the synthetic matrix (perf-bot to create results PR) 2) infra to add per-route config knobs (lisa + ben) 3) sre to add routing guard (sre-ops) 4) storage to prototype short TTL replication (jordan). I'll open tracking tickets. :thumbsup:

maria: one more note — watch out for quantized-kernel fallbacks; they sometimes trigger a different codepath with higher variance. Include quantization variants in the test matrix.

alex: good call. I'll add quantized variants to the matrix. Thanks all — please drop short notes in the ticket when you start.

sre-ops: FYI I've toggled the emergency routing flag to prefer local-degraded for the next 2h to observe production behavior. Monitor dashboards. :eyes:

ben: leaving a snippet here for the kernel policy toggle (will add to PR): ```--kernel-policy=low_variance --max-microbatch=8 --microbatch-slo=300```

jordan: adding endpoint to storage: `POST /kv/replicate?route=europe&ttl=600` to warm prefixes. I'll document in the ticket.

perf-bot: CI run scheduled: perf-matrix-20240712. Expect artifacts in ~45m.

alex: cool — closing thread for now. We'll reconvene when perf-matrix artifacts are in. :wave:
